in_sanskrit.name: Jiyaul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jiyaul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jiyaul is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' (victory) and 'Laxmi' (goddess of wealth). This name represents the triumph of prosperity and abundance in one's life.
